intent: Set to missing every genotype call that is supported by fewer than 10 reads; all the other genotypes and all the sites must stay in the output VCF.
silent_error: A bcftools filter expression on a FORMAT tag is evaluated per SITE: '-e FMT/DP<10' is true when ANY sample has DP<10, so the whole record is dropped (here 4 of 6 sites vanish, together with the good genotypes of the other samples) and no genotype is ever set to missing. Per-sample masking needs -S . (--set-GTs) so that only the failing samples are set to missing. Exit 0, nothing printed. Documented in the bcftools man page (filter -S/--set-GTs: 'set genotypes of failed samples to missing value') and in the bcftools filtering how-to, which explains that a FORMAT expression selects sites (any-sample semantics, & versus &&).
